数据展示

表格 AsamTable

展示已经获得的结构化行数据，并管理选择、排序和本地加载呈现。 默认 stripe=true 显示斑马纹，显式 :stripe="false" 可关闭；border 默认 false，显式 border 可开启，所有原生公开属性继续透传。

使用场景 ​

默认 stripe=true 显示斑马纹，显式 :stripe="false" 可关闭；border 默认 false，显式 border 可开启，所有原生公开属性继续透传。

展示已经获得的结构化行数据，并管理选择、排序和本地加载呈现。

表格使用独立的 AsamTableSize：large、default、small、mini 对应单行行高 60px、50px、42px、36px，默认 default。表头使用同档高度；多行或较高的自定义内容按原生表格自然撑高。表单和按钮的控件尺寸不随表格密度切换。

空数据区域最小高度为 400px，默认复用 AsamEmpty 插图和说明。empty 插槽可替换空内容；需要重载时，由持有数据源的高级表格或页面接入实际查询控制器，基础表格自身不发起请求。

契约与组合 ​

行数据由 data 提供，row-key 支持字段路径或函数。 完整说明。

getSelectionRows 返回全选行，getHalfSelectionRows 返回 checkStrictly=false 的真实半选父行；getSelection 是 ASAM 当前选择快照。 完整说明。

列的 prop 可以使用嵌套字段路径。 完整说明。

固定列、固定表头、分组表头、展开详情、树与懒加载、排序、筛选、合并及汇总都使用真实 Table / TableColumn 入口。 完整说明。

完整实例公开面 ​

ref 的顶层值采用 Vue 浅解包：直接读取 isEmpty / columns / tableLayout，不再读取 .value。 完整说明。

字段/方法 值与调用契约
ns 原生 namespace 视图，可读取 b / e / m 等类名函数。
layout 原生布局对象的只读借用视图；观察布局结果。
store 原生选择、列与树状态的只读借用视图；不承诺任意私有子命令。
columns 当前表头第一层的 TableColumnCtx<Row>[] 计算视图。
handleHeaderFooterMousewheel (event: WheelEvent, delta: { pixelX: number; pixelY: number })；处理已归一化的表头/表尾滚轮。
handleMouseLeave () => void；清除行悬停状态及原生 hover 记录。
tableId 原生实例的 string 标识。
tableSize 原生有效密度：空字符串 / large / default / small；ASAM 的 big 映射由尺寸作用域负责。
isHidden boolean；原生布局初始化隐藏状态。
isEmpty boolean；当前原生数据是否为空。
renderExpanded 原生显式 expose 的展开渲染器引用：函数或 null。2.14.7 的列实际写入 context.renderExpanded，因此展开正文可正常渲染而该独立引用仍为 null；不要据此判断是否存在展开列。
resizeProxyVisible boolean；表头调整列宽代理是否显示。
resizeState width / height / headerHeight 为 number 或 null 的测量视图。
isGroup boolean；是否存在分组表头。
bodyWidth string；原生表体布局宽度。
tableBodyStyles { width: string }；表体的计算样式。
emptyBlockStyle { width: string; height: string } 或 undefined；空数据块的计算样式。
debouncedUpdateLayout 可调用的延迟布局更新函数，同时保留 cancel() 与 flush()。
setCurrentRow (row?: Row) => void；设置当前行，无参数清除。
getSelectionRows () => Row[]；返回全选行。
getHalfSelectionRows () => Row[]；checkStrictly=false 时返回半选父行。
toggleRowSelection (row: Row, selected?: boolean, ignoreSelectable?: boolean) => void；切换或明确设定行选择。
clearSelection () => void；清除选择并抑制当前 ASAM 默认选择意图。
clearFilter (columnKeys?: string | string[]) => void；按列键或全部清除筛选。
toggleAllSelection () => void；切换全部行选择。
toggleRowExpansion (row: Row, expanded?: boolean) => void；切换详情/树展开。
clearSort () => void；清除排序。
doLayout () => void；重算原生布局。
sort (prop: string, order: string) => void；按公开列字段与原生排序顺序更新。
updateKeyChildren (key: string, children: Row[]) => void；更新已懒加载的子节点，并继续应用未被用户清除的默认子节点意图。
t 原生 Translator；按 locale 键和可选命名参数翻译。
setDragVisible (visible: boolean) => void；设置列宽拖动代理可见性。
context 原生 Table<Row> 上下文的只读借用视图；可观察当前原生上下文，私有子命令不作为稳定的业务 API。
computedSumText string；有效汇总标题。
computedEmptyText string；有效空数据文案。
computedTooltipEffect 有效 tooltip effect 或 undefined。
computedTooltipOptions 有效原生 tooltip options 对象或 undefined。
tableLayout auto / fixed；当前有效表格布局。
scrollbarViewStyle 原生滚动内容样式对象。
scrollbarStyle 随 height / maxHeight 与表头表尾高度计算的滚动视窗样式对象。
scrollBarRef 实际滚动条实例或 undefined（挂载前/卸载后）；支持 Scrollbar 公开方法和 DOM wrapRef。
scrollTo 原生 scrollTo 数字坐标或 ScrollToOptions 签名；滚动表体。
setScrollLeft (left?: number) => void；设置水平滚动位置。
setScrollTop (top?: number) => void；设置垂直滚动位置。
allowDragLastColumn boolean；原生显式 expose 的初始 prop 快照，不承诺响应式跟随后续 prop 改变。

默认选择支持树形后代与行键；懒加载后继续应用选择意图。 完整说明。

模板与预览边界 ​

TS 列插槽需要显式 Row 时，使用列前的 @vue-generic 注释；完整 usage-custom-column 与 basic 示例可直接运行。 完整说明。

基础用法与状态 ​

基础用法与状态

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="demo-root-layout">
		<label>
			<span>表格行高</span>
			<AsamSelect v-model="size">
				<AsamOption
					v-for="value in sizes"
					:key="value"
					:label="'size=' + value"
					:value="value"
				>
					size={{ value }}
				</AsamOption>
			</AsamSelect>
		</label>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="loading = !loading">
			切换本地加载状态
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="primary" plain native-type="button" @click="empty = !empty">
			{{ empty ? '恢复本地记录' : '查看空状态' }}
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamTable
			v-bind="{ data: empty ? [] : rows, rowKey: 'id', selectable: true, loading, size }"
			@selection-change="selection = $event"
		>
			<template #toolbar="{ selection: current }">
				<span>已选 {{ current.length }} 项</span>
			</template>
			<!-- @vue-generic {Row} -->
			<AsamTableColumn prop="name" label="名称" min-width="150">
				<template #default="{ row }">
					<span>{{ row.name }}</span>
				</template>
			</AsamTableColumn>
			<AsamTableColumn
				v-bind="{ prop: 'count', label: '数量', sortable: true, width: 100 }"
			/>
			<template #empty>没有本地记录</template>
		</AsamTable>
		<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">
			选中键：{{ selection.map((row) => row.id).join(', ') }}
		</p>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableBasicDemo' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamButton, AsamTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamTableSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Row {
	id: number;
	name: string;
	count: number;
}
const rows: Row[] = [
	{ id: 1, name: '本地草稿', count: 3 },
	{ id: 2, name: '已发布记录', count: 8 },
	{ id: 3, name: '待审核记录', count: 0 },
	{ id: 4, name: '已归档记录', count: 12 },
	{ id: 5, name: '已撤回记录', count: 3 }
];
const selection = ref<Row[]>([]);
const loading = ref(false);
const empty = ref(false);
const sizes: AsamTableSize[] = ['large', 'default', 'small', 'mini'];
const size = ref<AsamTableSize>('default');
</script>

<style scoped>
.demo-root-layout {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
	justify-items: start;
}
.demo-root-layout > :is(p, pre, output) {
	margin-block: 0;
}
</style>

<style scoped>
p:where(.example-paragraph) {
	margin-block: 16px;
	line-height: 1.8;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>

树后代与懒加载默认选择 ​

树后代与懒加载默认选择

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="demo-root-layout">
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="customChildren">使用 nodes 子节点字段</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamButton native-type="submit" type="default" @click="staticTable?.clearSelection()">
			清除树默认选择
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamTable
			ref="staticTable"
			:data="rows"
			row-key="id"
			selectable
			default-expand-all
			:default-selected-row-keys="[11]"
			:tree-props="{ children: customChildren ? 'nodes' : 'children', checkStrictly: true }"
			@selection-change="recordStatic"
		>
			<AsamTableColumn prop="label" label="静态树" />
		</AsamTable>
		<p class="example-paragraph" data-testid="tree-default-static">
			静态选择 {{ staticSelection.join(',') }}
		</p>
		<AsamTable
			:data="lazyRows"
			row-key="id"
			selectable
			lazy
			:default-selected-row-keys="[21]"
			:tree-props="{ children: 'children', hasChildren: 'hasChildren', checkStrictly: true }"
			:load="load"
			@selection-change="recordLazy"
		>
			<AsamTableColumn prop="label" label="懒加载树（展开后解析默认选择）" />
		</AsamTable>
		<p class="example-paragraph" data-testid="tree-default-lazy">
			懒加载选择 {{ lazySelection.join(',') }}
		</p>
	</div>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableTreeDefaultsDemo' });
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamCheckboxItem, AsamButton, AsamTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamTableExpose, AsamTableProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Row {
	id: number;
	label: string;
	children?: Row[];
	nodes?: Row[];
	hasChildren?: boolean;
}
const customChildren = ref(false);
const staticTable = shallowRef<AsamTableExpose<Row>>();
const staticSelection = ref<number[]>([]),
	lazySelection = ref<number[]>([]);
const rows = computed<Row[]>(() => [
	{
		id: 1,
		label: '父节点',
		[customChildren.value ? 'nodes' : 'children']: [
			{ id: 11, label: '默认选中子节点' },
			{ id: 12, label: '其他子节点' }
		]
	}
]);
const lazyRows: Row[] = [{ id: 2, label: '待加载父节点', hasChildren: true }];
const timers = new Set<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>();
let disposed = false;
function recordStatic(selection: Row[]): void {
	staticSelection.value = selection.map((row) => row.id);
}
function recordLazy(selection: Row[]): void {
	lazySelection.value = selection.map((row) => row.id);
}
const load: AsamTableProps<Row>['load'] = (_row, _node, resolve) => {
	const timer = setTimeout(() => {
		timers.delete(timer);
		if (!disposed) resolve([{ id: 21, label: '解析后默认选中子节点' }]);
	}, 150);
	timers.add(timer);
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	disposed = true;
	timers.forEach((timer) => clearTimeout(timer));
	timers.clear();
});
</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableUsageFilterDemo' });
import { AsamButton, AsamTable, AsamTableColumn, AsamTag } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { ref } from 'vue';

import type { AsamTableColumnCtx, AsamTableExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface User {
	date: string;
	name: string;
	address: string;
	tag: string;
}

const tableRef = ref<AsamTableExpose<User>>();

const resetDateFilter = () => {
	tableRef.value!.clearFilter(['date']);
};
const clearFilter = () => {
	tableRef.value!.clearFilter();
};
const formatter = (row: User) => {
	return row.address;
};
const filterTag = (value: string, row: User) => {
	return row.tag === value;
};
const filterHandler = (value: string, row: User, column: AsamTableColumnCtx<User>) => {
	const property = column['property'];
	return property in row && Reflect.get(row, property) === value;
};

const tableData: User[] = [
	{
		date: '2016-05-03',
		name: '汤姆',
		address: '洛杉矶格罗夫街 189 号',
		tag: '家'
	},
	{
		date: '2016-05-02',
		name: '汤姆',
		address: '洛杉矶格罗夫街 189 号',
		tag: '办公室'
	},
	{
		date: '2016-05-04',
		name: '汤姆',
		address: '洛杉矶格罗夫街 189 号',
		tag: '家'
	},
	{
		date: '2016-05-01',
		name: '汤姆',
		address: '洛杉矶格罗夫街 189 号',
		tag: '办公室'
	}
];
</script>

defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableUsageFixedHeaderWithFluidHeaderDemo' });
import { AsamTable, AsamTableColumn, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { ref } from 'vue';

const now = new Date();

const tableData = ref([
	{
		date: '2016-05-01',
		name: '汤姆',
		state: '加利福尼亚州',
		city: '洛杉矶',
		address: '洛杉矶格罗夫街 189 号',
		zip: 'CA 90036'
	},
	{
		date: '2016-05-02',
		name: '汤姆',
		state: '加利福尼亚州',
		city: '洛杉矶',
		address: '洛杉矶格罗夫街 189 号',
		zip: 'CA 90036'
	},
	{
		date: '2016-05-03',
		name: '汤姆',
		state: '加利福尼亚州',
		city: '洛杉矶',
		address: '洛杉矶格罗夫街 189 号',
		zip: 'CA 90036'
	}
]);

const deleteRow = (index: number) => {
	tableData.value.splice(index, 1);
};

const onAddItem = () => {
	now.setDate(now.getDate() + 1);
	tableData.value.push({
		date: now.toISOString().slice(0, 10),
		name: '汤姆',
		state: '加利福尼亚州',
		city: '洛杉矶',
		address: '洛杉矶格罗夫街 189 号',
		zip: 'CA 90036'
	});
};
</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableUsageMultiSelectDemo' });
import { AsamTable, AsamTableColumn, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { ref } from 'vue';

import type { AsamTableExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface User {
	id: number;
	date: string;
	name: string;
	address: string;
}

const multipleTableRef = ref<AsamTableExpose<User>>();
const multipleSelection = ref<User[]>([]);

const selectable = (row: User) => ![1, 2].includes(row.id);
const toggleSelection = (rows?: User[], ignoreSelectable?: boolean) => {
	if (rows) {
		rows.forEach((row) => {
			multipleTableRef.value!.toggleRowSelection(row, undefined, ignoreSelectable);
		});
	} else {
		multipleTableRef.value!.clearSelection();
	}
};
const handleSelectionChange = (val: User[]) => {
	multipleSelection.value = val;
};

const tableData: User[] = [
	{
		id: 1,
		date: '2016-05-03',
		name: '汤姆',
		address: '洛杉矶格罗夫街 189 号'
	},
	{
		id: 2,
		date: '2016-05-02',
		name: '汤姆',
		address: '洛杉矶格罗夫街 189 号'
	},
	{
		id: 3,
		date: '2016-05-04',
		name: '汤姆',
		address: '洛杉矶格罗夫街 189 号'
	},
	{
		id: 4,
		date: '2016-05-01',
		name: '汤姆',
		address: '洛杉矶格罗夫街 189 号'
	},
	{
		id: 5,
		date: '2016-05-08',
		name: '汤姆',
		address: '洛杉矶格罗夫街 189 号'
	},
	{
		id: 6,
		date: '2016-05-06',
		name: '汤姆',
		address: '洛杉矶格罗夫街 189 号'
	},
	{
		id: 7,
		date: '2016-05-07',
		name: '汤姆',
		address: '洛杉矶格罗夫街 189 号'
	}
];
</script>

<script setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableUsageMultiSelectDemo' });
import { AsamTable, AsamTableColumn, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { ref } from 'vue';
const multipleTableRef = ref();
const multipleSelection = ref([]);
const selectable = (row) => ![1, 2].includes(row.id);
const toggleSelection = (rows, ignoreSelectable) => {
	if (rows) {
		rows.forEach((row) => {
			multipleTableRef.value.toggleRowSelection(row, undefined, ignoreSelectable);
		});
	} else {
		multipleTableRef.value.clearSelection();
	}
};
const handleSelectionChange = (val) => {
	multipleSelection.value = val;
};

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableUsageRowspanAndColspanDemo' });
import { AsamTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import type { AsamTableColumnCtx } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface User {
	id: string;
	name: string;
	amount1: string;
	amount2: string;
	amount3: number;
}

interface SpanMethodProps {
	row: User;
	column: AsamTableColumnCtx<User>;
	rowIndex: number;
	columnIndex: number;
}

const arraySpanMethod = ({ rowIndex, columnIndex }: SpanMethodProps) => {
	if (rowIndex % 2 === 0) {
		if (columnIndex === 0) {
			return [1, 2];
		} else if (columnIndex === 1) {
			return [0, 0];
		}
	}
};

const objectSpanMethod = ({ rowIndex, columnIndex }: SpanMethodProps) => {
	if (columnIndex === 0) {
		if (rowIndex % 2 === 0) {
			return {
				rowspan: 2,
				colspan: 1
			};
		} else {
			return {
				rowspan: 0,
				colspan: 0
			};
		}
	}
};

const tableData: User[] = [
	{
		id: '12987122',
		name: '汤姆',

		amount2: '3.2',

];

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableUsageSummaryDemo' });
import { AsamTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { h } from 'vue';

import type { VNode } from 'vue';
import type { AsamTableColumnCtx } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface Product {
	id: string;
	name: string;
	amount1: string;
	amount2: string;
	amount3: number;
}

interface SummaryMethodProps<T extends Product = Product> {
	columns: AsamTableColumnCtx<T>[];
	data: T[];
}

const getSummaries = (param: SummaryMethodProps) => {
	const { columns, data } = param;
	const sums: (string | VNode)[] = [];
	columns.forEach((column, index) => {
		if (index === 0) {
			sums[index] = h('div', { style: { textDecoration: 'underline' } }, ['总费用']);
			return;
		}
		const values = data.map((item) => Number(Reflect.get(item, column.property)));
		if (!values.every((value) => Number.isNaN(value))) {
			sums[index] = `$ ${values.reduce((prev, curr) => {
				const value = Number(curr);
				if (!Number.isNaN(value)) {
					return prev + curr;
				} else {
					return prev;
				}
			}, 0)}`;
		} else {
			sums[index] = 'N/A';
		}
	});

	return sums;
};

const tableData: Product[] = [
	{
		id: '12987122',
		name: '汤姆',
		amount1: '234',
		amount2: '3.2',
		amount3: 10
	},
	{
		id: '12987123',
		name: '汤姆',
		amount1: '165',
		amount2: '4.43',
		amount3: 12
	},
	{
		id: '12987124',
		name: '汤姆',
		amount1: '324',
		amount2: '1.9',
		amount3: 9
	},
	{
		id: '12987125',
		name: '汤姆',
		amount1: '621',
		amount2: '2.2',
		amount3: 17
	},
	{
		id: '12987126',
		name: '汤姆',
		amount1: '539',
		amount2: '4.1',
		amount3: 15
	}
];
</script>

<template>
	<div>

			<template v-if="showAppend" #append>
				<div class="append-actions">
					<AsamButton type="primary" @click="add">追加一行</AsamButton>
					<span>已追加 {{ added }} 行</span>
				</div>
			</template>
			<template #empty>暂无商品，可通过追加操作添加。</template>
		</AsamTable>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableAppendSummaryDemo' });
import { computed, h, ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamSelect,
	AsamOption,
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamTable,
	AsamTableColumn
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamTableProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Product {
	id: number;
	name: string;
	amount: number;
}
const layout = ref<'auto' | 'fixed'>('auto');
const showSummary = ref(true),
	showAppend = ref(true),
	empty = ref(false);
const customSummary = ref(false),
	fixedHeight = ref(false),
	added = ref(0);
const rows = ref<Product[]>([
	{ id: 1, name: '商品 A', amount: 2 },
	{ id: 2, name: '商品 B', amount: 3 }
]);
const visibleRows = computed(() => (empty.value ? [] : rows.value));
const summaries: NonNullable<AsamTableProps<Product>['summaryMethod']> = ({ data }) => [
	h('strong', '数量合计'),
	String(data.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.amount, 0))
];
function add() {
	const id = rows.value.length + 1;
	rows.value.push({ id, name: `商品 ${id}`, amount: 1 });
	added.value++;
	empty.value = false;
}
</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableUsageTooltipFormatterDemo' });
import { AsamTable, AsamTableColumn, AsamTag } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { h } from 'vue';
import { AsamLink, type AsamTableTooltipData } from '@asam-ui/ui';

type TableData = {
	address: string;
	tags: string[];
	url: string;
};

const tableData: TableData[] = [
	{
		address: '萨尔州南莉莉洛尔贝格路 86c 号',
		tags: ['办公室', '家', '公园', '花园'],
		url: '/component-AsamTable.html'
	},
	{
		address: '伊利诺伊州南弗兰克菲尔德 A 街 760 号',
		tags: ['error', 'warning', 'success', 'info'],

	},
	{

		tags: ['blue', 'white', 'dark', 'gray', 'red', 'bright'],
		url: '/component-AsamTable.html'
	}
];

const tableRowFormatter = (data: AsamTableTooltipData<TableData>) => {
	return `${data.cellValue}：表格格式化内容`;
};

const withVNode = (data: AsamTableTooltipData<TableData>) => {
	return h(AsamLink, { type: 'primary', href: data.cellValue }, () =>
		h('span', null, data.cellValue)
	);
};
</script>

		h('span', null, data.cellValue)
	);
};
</script>

const selected = shallowRef<keyof typeof scenarios>('append-summary/ts');
function selectScenario(value: unknown) {
	const option = options.find((option) => option.value === value);
	if (option) selected.value = option.value;
}
const current = computed(() => scenarios[selected.value]);
</script>

<template>
	<div>
		<p class="example-paragraph">追加内容位于汇总行上方；固定高度时滚动到底部查看追加操作。</p>
		<label>
			<span>布局</span>
			<AsamSelect v-model="layout">
				<AsamOption :label="'auto'" :value="'auto'">auto</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption :label="'fixed'" :value="'fixed'">fixed</AsamOption>
			</AsamSelect>
		</label>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="showSummary">汇总</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="showAppend">追加内容</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="empty">空表</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="customSummary">自定义 VNode 汇总</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="fixedHeight">固定高度</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamTable
			:data="visibleRows"
			:table-layout="layout"
			:show-summary="showSummary"
			:summary-method="customSummary ? summaries : undefined"
			:height="fixedHeight ? 260 : undefined"
			row-key="id"
			border
		>
			<AsamTableColumn prop="name" label="商品" min-width="160" />
			<AsamTableColumn prop="amount" label="数量" min-width="120" />

	AsamSelect,

	AsamCheckboxItem,

} from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface Product {

	name: string;
	amount: number;
}

]);

		<AsamButton native-type="submit" type="default" @click="staticTable?.clearSelection()">

			:tree-props="{ children: customChildren ? 'nodes' : 'children', checkStrictly: true }"
			@selection-change="recordStatic"
		>

		</p>
		<AsamTable
			:data="lazyRows"
			row-key="id"
			selectable
			lazy
			:default-selected-row-keys="[21]"
			:tree-props="{ children: 'children', hasChildren: 'hasChildren', checkStrictly: true }"
			:load="load"
			@selection-change="recordLazy"
		>
			<AsamTableColumn prop="label" label="懒加载树（展开后解析默认选择）" />
		</AsamTable>
		<p class="example-paragraph" data-testid="tree-default-lazy">
			懒加载选择 {{ lazySelection.join(',') }}

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableTreeDefaultsDemo' });
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamCheckboxItem, AsamButton, AsamTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamTableExpose, AsamTableProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Row {
	id: number;
	label: string;
	children?: Row[];
	nodes?: Row[];
	hasChildren?: boolean;
}
const customChildren = ref(false);
const staticTable = shallowRef<AsamTableExpose<Row>>();
const staticSelection = ref<number[]>([]),
	lazySelection = ref<number[]>([]);
const rows = computed<Row[]>(() => [
	{
		id: 1,
		label: '父节点',
		[customChildren.value ? 'nodes' : 'children']: [
			{ id: 11, label: '默认选中子节点' },
			{ id: 12, label: '其他子节点' }
		]
	}
]);
const lazyRows: Row[] = [{ id: 2, label: '待加载父节点', hasChildren: true }];
const timers = new Set<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>();
let disposed = false;
function recordStatic(selection: Row[]): void {
	staticSelection.value = selection.map((row) => row.id);
}
function recordLazy(selection: Row[]): void {
	lazySelection.value = selection.map((row) => row.id);
}
const load: AsamTableProps<Row>['load'] = (_row, _node, resolve) => {
	const timer = setTimeout(() => {
		timers.delete(timer);
		if (!disposed) resolve([{ id: 21, label: '解析后默认选中子节点' }]);
	}, 150);
	timers.add(timer);
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	disposed = true;
	timers.forEach((timer) => clearTimeout(timer));
	timers.clear();
});
</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableUsageFilterDemo' });
import { AsamButton, AsamTable, AsamTableColumn, AsamTag } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { ref } from 'vue';

import type { AsamTableColumnCtx, AsamTableExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface User {
	date: string;
	name: string;
	address: string;
	tag: string;
}

const tableRef = ref<AsamTableExpose<User>>();

const resetDateFilter = () => {
	tableRef.value!.clearFilter(['date']);
};
const clearFilter = () => {
	tableRef.value!.clearFilter();
};
const formatter = (row: User) => {
	return row.address;
};
const filterTag = (value: string, row: User) => {
	return row.tag === value;
};
const filterHandler = (value: string, row: User, column: AsamTableColumnCtx<User>) => {
	const property = column['property'];
	return property in row && Reflect.get(row, property) === value;
};

const tableData: User[] = [
	{
		date: '2016-05-03',
		name: '汤姆',
		address: '洛杉矶格罗夫街 189 号',

	},

	}
];

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableUsageFixedHeaderWithFluidHeaderDemo' });
import { AsamTable, AsamTableColumn, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { ref } from 'vue';

const now = new Date();

const tableData = ref([
	{
		date: '2016-05-01',
		name: '汤姆',
		state: '加利福尼亚州',
		city: '洛杉矶',
		address: '洛杉矶格罗夫街 189 号',
		zip: 'CA 90036'
	},
	{
		date: '2016-05-02',
		name: '汤姆',
		state: '加利福尼亚州',
		city: '洛杉矶',
		address: '洛杉矶格罗夫街 189 号',
		zip: 'CA 90036'
	},
	{
		date: '2016-05-03',
		name: '汤姆',
		state: '加利福尼亚州',
		city: '洛杉矶',
		address: '洛杉矶格罗夫街 189 号',
		zip: 'CA 90036'
	}
]);

const deleteRow = (index: number) => {
	tableData.value.splice(index, 1);
};

const onAddItem = () => {
	now.setDate(now.getDate() + 1);
	tableData.value.push({
		date: now.toISOString().slice(0, 10),
		name: '汤姆',
		state: '加利福尼亚州',
		city: '洛杉矶',
		address: '洛杉矶格罗夫街 189 号',
		zip: 'CA 90036'
	});
};
</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableUsageRowspanAndColspanDemo' });
import { AsamTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import type { AsamTableColumnCtx } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface User {
	id: string;
	name: string;
	amount1: string;
	amount2: string;
	amount3: number;
}

interface SpanMethodProps {
	row: User;
	column: AsamTableColumnCtx<User>;
	rowIndex: number;
	columnIndex: number;
}

const arraySpanMethod = ({ rowIndex, columnIndex }: SpanMethodProps) => {
	if (rowIndex % 2 === 0) {
		if (columnIndex === 0) {
			return [1, 2];
		} else if (columnIndex === 1) {
			return [0, 0];
		}
	}
};

const objectSpanMethod = ({ rowIndex, columnIndex }: SpanMethodProps) => {
	if (columnIndex === 0) {
		if (rowIndex % 2 === 0) {
			return {
				rowspan: 2,
				colspan: 1
			};
		} else {
			return {
				rowspan: 0,
				colspan: 0
			};
		}
	}
};

const tableData: User[] = [
	{
		id: '12987122',
		name: '汤姆',
		amount1: '234',
		amount2: '3.2',
		amount3: 10

];
</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableUsageSummaryDemo' });
import { AsamTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { h } from 'vue';

import type { VNode } from 'vue';
import type { AsamTableColumnCtx } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface Product {
	id: string;
	name: string;
	amount1: string;
	amount2: string;
	amount3: number;
}

interface SummaryMethodProps<T extends Product = Product> {
	columns: AsamTableColumnCtx<T>[];
	data: T[];
}

const getSummaries = (param: SummaryMethodProps) => {
	const { columns, data } = param;
	const sums: (string | VNode)[] = [];
	columns.forEach((column, index) => {
		if (index === 0) {
			sums[index] = h('div', { style: { textDecoration: 'underline' } }, ['总费用']);
			return;
		}
		const values = data.map((item) => Number(Reflect.get(item, column.property)));
		if (!values.every((value) => Number.isNaN(value))) {
			sums[index] = `$ ${values.reduce((prev, curr) => {
				const value = Number(curr);
				if (!Number.isNaN(value)) {
					return prev + curr;
				} else {
					return prev;
				}
			}, 0)}`;
		} else {
			sums[index] = 'N/A';
		}
	});

	return sums;
};

const tableData: Product[] = [
	{
		id: '12987122',
		name: '汤姆',
		amount1: '234',
		amount2: '3.2',
		amount3: 10

		amount3: 9
	},
	{

		amount3: 17
	},
	{
		id: '12987126',
		name: '汤姆',
		amount1: '539',
		amount2: '4.1',
		amount3: 15
	}
];
</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableUsageTreeAndLazyDemo' });
import { AsamTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface User {
	id: number;

	name: string;
	address: string;
	hasChildren?: boolean;
	children?: User[];
}

const load = (row: User, treeNode: unknown, resolve: (data: User[]) => void) => {
	setTimeout(() => {
		resolve([
			{
				id: 31,
				date: '2016-05-01',
				name: '王小虎',

# AsamTable 全部场景

Node22.19+的22.x、pnpm11.9.0。在本目录执行pnpm install --frozen-lockfile、pnpm run typecheck、pnpm run dev、pnpm run build。vendor为固定正常包，保留锁文件和patches，不引用网站源码或借用node_modules。

界面中的场景选择器列出本组件全部真实TS/JS用法。src/examples/<场景>/<语言>/保留各场景原文件名、相对导入和资产；文件没有拼接进Demo.vue。主入口与所有场景配置也在文档的完整工程文件面板中。选择另一个场景会卸载前一个实例；文档中只切源文件则不会重挂载。

演示许可与第三方说明位于LICENSE、THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md及来源文件同目录的LICENSE-<摘要>.txt。

# Third-party notices

`@asam-ui/ui` uses the following direct runtime dependencies for AsamEditor. The
library build is configured to treat them as external dependencies installed by
the consumer's package manager. Package metadata and license files were checked
on 2026-09-25.

runtime packages, all with MIT license files in the checked local installation.
The installed distributions carry their respective license texts. Applications
that bundle or redistribute these dependencies must preserve their applicable
copyright and license notices. Check the actual resolved dependencies and build
output before distribution. No Tiptap Pro package, UI component, template, or

## Component compatibility sources and build helpers

Cascader, Image, ImageViewer and Anchor delegate their basic public behavior to
the installed Element Plus 2.14.7 components. ASAM supplies its styles and
documented advanced value adapters; it does not carry derived setup/render
implementations, bounded zoom, keyboard focus patches or Anchor scroll handling.

The former compatibility implementations used Element Plus gitHead
`77d5c32c4ebcfffde67e51f6325c6d350ca668a0`. Their original source identities
are retained here for historical provenance: the Cascader distribution module
SHA256 was `bac94ed4602841106d134f39056fdaca0d7fbb711fc8ff4339b7fac65391ea82`;
Anchor source `packages/components/anchor/src/anchor.vue` SHA256 was
`3a60f68d455f3e582ecffd4639c78ee24fcbf0a2bcfe0ce0cddf03583d78af2f`.
These historical identities do not imply that the derived runtime remains in
this native-delegation candidate. The original Element Plus license follows.

Build helper inputs are pinned to VueUse core 15.0.0, Element Plus Icons Vue
2.3.2 and Lodash ES 4.18.1. Other components may still use these helpers;
removing the four derived implementations does not remove their notices.
VueUse shared and metadata 15.0.0 carry the same license text as core. The
following original notices remain applicable to retained source and helper
inputs; the installed Element Plus components and Vue remain peer dependencies.

## Private declaration snapshots

The normal declaration build redistributes 590 Element Plus 2.14.7 ES declarations
and 295 Element Plus Icons Vue 2.3.2 declarations under `dist/_upstream`.
The original declaration and producer-patch hashes, module-path adaptations and
output hashes are recorded in `dist/_upstream/provenance.json` and the build input
`tools/eng-006/upstream-declarations.lock.json`. The fixed Element Plus source
identity is `77d5c32c4ebcfffde67e51f6325c6d350ca668a0`.

Eight Element Plus declarations receive the recorded strong-type corrections.
Relative declaration references use explicit NodeNext extensions. The Color
class, installation key, table placeholder key and loading directive declaration
are exact re-exports of the original peer declaration leaves, preserving private
member and unique-symbol identity. These snapshots have no runtime entry point.

The complete original MIT licenses are redistributed with each declaration
snapshot at `dist/_upstream/element-plus/LICENSE` and
`dist/_upstream/icons-vue/LICENSE`. The Element Plus and Icons Vue copyright and
license texts above also apply to these declaration derivatives. External type
providers remain normal installed dependencies; their declarations are not
copied into these snapshots.

用法与契约补充说明 ​

契约与组合 ​

行数据由 data 提供，row-key 支持字段路径或函数。原生表格 props、事件与实例方法保留 Row 泛型；ASAM 增加四档 size（控件密度）、loading、默认选中键、跨数据刷新选择保留、工具栏和分页。密度使用 large / big / default / small；行高由内容和行密度决定。使用 selectable 生成选择列，或自行放置 type="selection" 的列，两种方式任选其一。defaultSelectedRowKeys 是默认选择意图；用户清除或取消后的选择不会因无关刷新反复恢复。

契约与组合 ​

getSelectionRows 返回全选行，getHalfSelectionRows 返回 checkStrictly=false 的真实半选父行；getSelection 是 ASAM 当前选择快照。实例参数及返回值保留具体 Row，类型示例同时拒绝错误字段。row-click / row-contextmenu / row-dblclick 的 column 可能为 null，清空排序时 sort-change.prop 可能为 null。

契约与组合 ​

列的 prop 可以使用嵌套字段路径。父 Table 的 Row 不会自动成为所有子列的模板类型；TS 作用域插槽在对应列前添加 <!-- @vue-generic {Row} -->，或用 const RowColumn = AsamTableColumn<Row>。JS 使用普通数据对象。tooltipFormatter 支持字符串和 VNode，Table 的默认格式可以被某一列覆盖。

契约与组合 ​

固定列、固定表头、分组表头、展开详情、树与懒加载、排序、筛选、合并及汇总都使用真实 Table / TableColumn 入口。懒加载 resolve 在 Table 卸载后被忽略，避免迟到数据改变已销毁实例；宿主定时器或请求仍由宿主在卸载时取消。filteredValue 属于父状态，确认面板筛选不会原地修改传入数组。

完整实例公开面 ​

ref 的顶层值采用 Vue 浅解包：直接读取 isEmpty / columns / tableLayout，不再读取 .value。全部45项对齐固定2.14.7的显式 defineExpose；对象视图只读借用，不直接修改，业务动作优先使用具名公开方法。具体类型由 AsamTableExpose<Row> 保留；ASAM 另加 getSelection(): Row[] 当前选择快照。

模板与预览边界 ​

TS 列插槽需要显式 Row 时，使用列前的 @vue-generic 注释；完整 usage-custom-column 与 basic 示例可直接运行。图片可以作为列的 default 内容；预览由 AsamImage 提供，设置其 previewTeleported 为 true 将预览层传送到外部，避免表格固定列或滚动层的裁剪。表格负责承载普通插槽内容，图片及预览能力以该组件文档为准。直接写在 HTML DOM 中的组件必须使用完整闭合标签；SFC 编译支持自闭合，但浏览器 HTML 解析器不会将自定义标签当作 input/img。

追加内容与汇总行 ​

append 用于最后一条数据之后的操作区域。开启 show-summary 时，追加内容显示在汇总行上方；table-layout="auto" 与 fixed 均遵守这个顺序。固定高度的表格保留汇总行的原生吸底行为，滚动到底部可见追加操作。summary-method 仍可返回字符串或 VNode，自定义空表插槽位于追加内容之前。

更多参数与事件说明 ​

完整实例公开面 ​

默认选中遍历 treeProps.children（默认 children）的所有后代，支持嵌套字符串与函数 row-key；懒加载 resolve 后继续应用默认意图，公开 updateKeyChildren 更新已记录子节点。用户清除、单行取消、全选清除或关联父行取消后，无关数据刷新不会恢复被取消的默认后代。完整 tree-defaults 示例包含自定义 nodes、静态后代与延迟解析子节点，宿主取消自有计时器。

rowKey

import type { VNode } from 'vue';
import type { AsamTableProps, AsamTableSize, AsamTableRowKeyGetter, AsamTableRowKey, AsamPaginationProps, AsamTableOverflowTooltipOptions, AsamTableV2Props, AsamTableV2Expose, AsamControlSize, AsamTableSummaryMethod, AsamTableColumnCtx, AsamTableColumnCls, AsamTableColumnStyle, AsamTableV2HeaderCellSlotProps, AsamTableCellCls, AsamTableCellStyle, AsamTableSort, AsamTableTreeNode, AsamTableOverflowTooltipFormatter } from '@asam-ui/ui';

type PublicMember<T, K extends PropertyKey> = T extends unknown ? K extends keyof T ? T[K] : never : never;

// AsamTableProps
type PublicContract<Row extends object = object> = {
	"size"?: AsamTableSize | undefined;
	"data"?: Row[] | undefined;
	"stripe"?: boolean | undefined;
	"border"?: boolean | undefined;
	"tableLayout"?: ("auto" | "fixed") | undefined;

	"rowKey"?: string | AsamTableRowKeyGetter<Row> | undefined;

	"minWidth"?: string | undefined;
	"pagination"?: AsamPaginationProps | undefined;
	"allowDragLastColumn"?: boolean | undefined;
	"preserveExpandedContent"?: boolean | undefined;
	"style"?: AsamTableProps<Row>["style"];
	"className"?: string | undefined;
	"width"?: string | number | undefined;
	"height"?: string | number | undefined;
	"maxHeight"?: string | number | undefined;
	"fit"?: boolean | undefined;
	"showHeader"?: boolean | undefined;
	"showSummary"?: boolean | undefined;
	"sumText"?: string | undefined;
	"summaryMethod"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["summaryMethod"];
	"rowClassName"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["rowClassName"];
	"rowStyle"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["rowStyle"];
	"cellClassName"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["cellClassName"];
	"cellStyle"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["cellStyle"];
	"headerRowClassName"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["headerRowClassName"];
	"headerRowStyle"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["headerRowStyle"];
	"headerCellClassName"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["headerCellClassName"];
	"headerCellStyle"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["headerCellStyle"];
	"highlightCurrentRow"?: boolean | undefined;
	"currentRowKey"?: string | number | undefined;
	"emptyText"?: string | undefined;
	"expandRowKeys"?: string[] | undefined;
	"defaultExpandAll"?: boolean | undefined;
	"rowExpandable"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["rowExpandable"];
	"defaultSort"?: AsamTableSort | undefined;
	"tooltipEffect"?: string | undefined;
	"tooltipOptions"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["tooltipOptions"];
	"spanMethod"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["spanMethod"];
	"selectOnIndeterminate"?: boolean | undefined;
	"indent"?: number | undefined;

import type { AsamTableEmits, AsamTableColumnCtx } from '@asam-ui/ui';

// AsamTableEmits
type PublicContract<Row extends object = object> = {
	"select": [selection: Row[], row: Row];
	"select-all": [selection: Row[]];
	"selection-change": [selection: Row[]];
	"cell-mouse-enter": [row: Row, column: AsamTableColumnCtx<Row>, cell: HTMLTableCellElement, event: MouseEvent];
	"cell-mouse-leave": [row: Row, column: AsamTableColumnCtx<Row>, cell: HTMLTableCellElement, event: MouseEvent];
	"cell-contextmenu": [row: Row, column: AsamTableColumnCtx<Row>, cell: HTMLTableCellElement, event: PointerEvent];
	"cell-click": [row: Row, column: AsamTableColumnCtx<Row>, cell: HTMLTableCellElement, event: PointerEvent];
	"cell-dblclick": [row: Row, column: AsamTableColumnCtx<Row>, cell: HTMLTableCellElement, event: MouseEvent];
	"row-click": [row: Row, column: AsamTableColumnCtx<Row> | null, event: PointerEvent];
	"row-contextmenu": [row: Row, column: AsamTableColumnCtx<Row> | null, event: PointerEvent];
	"row-dblclick": [row: Row, column: AsamTableColumnCtx<Row> | null, event: MouseEvent];
	"header-click": [column: AsamTableColumnCtx<Row>, event: PointerEvent];
	"header-contextmenu": [column: AsamTableColumnCtx<Row>, event: PointerEvent];
	"sort-change": [sort: { column: AsamTableColumnCtx<Row>; prop: string | null; order: "ascending" | "descending" | null; }];
	"filter-change": [filters: Record<string, string[]>];
	"current-change": [currentRow: Row | null, oldCurrentRow: Row | null];
	"header-dragend": [newWidth: number, oldWidth: number, column: AsamTableColumnCtx<Row>, event: MouseEvent];
	"expand-change": [row: Row, expanded: boolean | Row[]];
	"scroll": [position: { scrollLeft: number; scrollTop: number; }];
	"page-change": [page: number];
	"page-size-change": [pageSize: number];
};

ts
import type { VNode, Ref, ReactiveEffect, ConcreteComponent, ComputedOptions, MethodOptions, AppContext, RendererNode, RendererElement, ComponentPublicInstance, ComponentOptionsBase, ComponentProvideOptions } from 'vue';
import type { AsamTableExpose, AsamTableContext, AsamTableRefs, AsamTableColumnCtx, AsamTableSize, AsamTableNativeEmits, AsamTableSort, AsamTableV2Expose, AsamTableV2Props, AsamTableFilter, AsamTableOverflowTooltipOptions, AsamScrollbarDirection } from '@asam-ui/ui';

type PublicMember<T, K extends PropertyKey> = T extends unknown ? K extends keyof T ? T[K] : never : never;

// AsamTableExpose
type PublicContract<Row extends object = object> = {
	readonly "sort": (prop: string, order: string) => void;
	readonly "context": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["context"];
	readonly "tableLayout": "auto" | "fixed";
	readonly "allowDragLastColumn": boolean;
	readonly "ns": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["ns"];
	readonly "layout": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["layout"];
	readonly "store": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["store"];
	readonly "columns": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["columns"];
	readonly "handleMouseLeave": () => void;
	readonly "tableId": string;
	readonly "tableSize": "" | "large" | "default" | "small";
	readonly "isHidden": boolean;
	readonly "isEmpty": boolean;
	readonly "renderExpanded": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["renderExpanded"];
	readonly "resizeProxyVisible": boolean;
	readonly "resizeState": { width: null | number; height: null | number; headerHeight: null | number; };
	readonly "isGroup": boolean;
	readonly "bodyWidth": string;
	readonly "tableBodyStyles": { width: string; };
	readonly "emptyBlockStyle": { width: string; height: string; } | undefined;
	readonly "debouncedUpdateLayout": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["debouncedUpdateLayout"];
	readonly "setCurrentRow": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["setCurrentRow"];
	readonly "getSelectionRows": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["getSelectionRows"];
	readonly "getHalfSelectionRows": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["getHalfSelectionRows"];
	readonly "toggleRowSelection": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["toggleRowSelection"];
	readonly "clearSelection": () => void;
	readonly "clearFilter": (columnKeys?: string[] | string) => void;
	readonly "toggleAllSelection": () => void;
	readonly "toggleRowExpansion": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["toggleRowExpansion"];
	readonly "clearSort": () => void;
	readonly "doLayout": () => void;
	readonly "updateKeyChildren": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["updateKeyChildren"];
	readonly "t": AsamTableExpose<Row>["t"];
	readonly "setDragVisible": (visible: boolean) => void;
	readonly "computedSumText": string;
	readonly "computedEmptyText": string;
	readonly "computedTooltipEffect": string | undefined;
	readonly "computedTooltipOptions": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["computedTooltipOptions"];
	readonly "scrollbarViewStyle": { display: string; verticalAlign: string; };
	readonly "scrollbarStyle": { height: string; maxHeight?: undefined; } | { maxHeight: string; height?: undefined; } | { height?: undefined; maxHeight?: undefined; };
	readonly "scrollTo": (options: ScrollToOptions | number, yCoord?: number) => void;
	readonly "setScrollLeft": (left?: number) => void;
	readonly "setScrollTop": (top?: number) => void;
	readonly "scrollBarRef": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["scrollBarRef"];
	readonly "handleHeaderFooterMousewheel": (event: WheelEvent, delta: { pixelX: number; pixelY: number; }) => void;
	"getSelection": () => Row[];
};

AsamTableInstance 公开类型视图
ts
import type { VNode, Ref, ReactiveEffect, ConcreteComponent, ComputedOptions, MethodOptions, AppContext, RendererNode, RendererElement, ComponentPublicInstance, ComponentOptionsBase, ComponentProvideOptions } from 'vue';
import type { AsamTableInstance, AsamTableContext, AsamTableRefs, AsamTableColumnCtx, AsamTableSize, AsamTableNativeEmits, AsamTableSort, AsamTableV2Expose, AsamTableV2Props, AsamTableFilter, AsamTableOverflowTooltipOptions, AsamScrollbarDirection } from '@asam-ui/ui';

type PublicMember<T, K extends PropertyKey> = T extends unknown ? K extends keyof T ? T[K] : never : never;

// AsamTableInstance
type PublicContract<Row extends object = object> = {
	readonly "sort": (prop: string, order: string) => void;
	readonly "context": (AsamTableInstance<Row>)["context"];
	readonly "tableLayout": "auto" | "fixed";
	readonly "allowDragLastColumn": boolean;
	readonly "ns": (AsamTableInstance<Row>)["ns"];
	readonly "layout": (AsamTableInstance<Row>)["layout"];
	readonly "store": (AsamTableInstance<Row>)["store"];
	readonly "columns": (AsamTableInstance<Row>)["columns"];
	readonly "handleMouseLeave": () => void;
	readonly "tableId": string;
	readonly "tableSize": "" | "large" | "default" | "small";
	readonly "isHidden": boolean;
	readonly "isEmpty": boolean;
	readonly "renderExpanded": (AsamTableInstance<Row>)["renderExpanded"];
	readonly "resizeProxyVisible": boolean;
	readonly "resizeState": { width: null | number; height: null | number; headerHeight: null | number; };
	readonly "isGroup": boolean;
	readonly "bodyWidth": string;
	readonly "tableBodyStyles": { width: string; };
	readonly "emptyBlockStyle": { width: string; height: string; } | undefined;
	readonly "debouncedUpdateLayout": (AsamTableInstance<Row>)["debouncedUpdateLayout"];
	readonly "setCurrentRow": (AsamTableInstance<Row>)["setCurrentRow"];
	readonly "getSelectionRows": (AsamTableInstance<Row>)["getSelectionRows"];
	readonly "getHalfSelectionRows": (AsamTableInstance<Row>)["getHalfSelectionRows"];
	readonly "toggleRowSelection": (AsamTableInstance<Row>)["toggleRowSelection"];
	readonly "clearSelection": () => void;
	readonly "clearFilter": (columnKeys?: string[] | string) => void;
	readonly "toggleAllSelection": () => void;
	readonly "toggleRowExpansion": (AsamTableInstance<Row>)["toggleRowExpansion"];
	readonly "clearSort": () => void;
	readonly "doLayout": () => void;
	readonly "updateKeyChildren": (AsamTableInstance<Row>)["updateKeyChildren"];
	readonly "t": AsamTableInstance<Row>["t"];
	readonly "setDragVisible": (visible: boolean) => void;
	readonly "computedSumText": string;
	readonly "computedEmptyText": string;
	readonly "computedTooltipEffect": string | undefined;
	readonly "computedTooltipOptions": (AsamTableInstance<Row>)["computedTooltipOptions"];
	readonly "scrollbarViewStyle": { display: string; verticalAlign: string; };
	readonly "scrollbarStyle": { height: string; maxHeight?: undefined; } | { maxHeight: string; height?: undefined; } | { height?: undefined; maxHeight?: undefined; };
	readonly "scrollTo": (options: ScrollToOptions | number, yCoord?: number) => void;
	readonly "setScrollLeft": (left?: number) => void;
	readonly "setScrollTop": (top?: number) => void;
	readonly "scrollBarRef": (AsamTableInstance<Row>)["scrollBarRef"];
	readonly "handleHeaderFooterMousewheel": (event: WheelEvent, delta: { pixelX: number; pixelY: number; }) => void;
	"getSelection": () => Row[];
};

	"_self": AsamTableContext<T>;
	"column": AsamTableColumnCtx<T>;
	"row": T;
	"$index": number;
	"cellIndex": number;
	"treeNode"?: AsamTableTreeNode | undefined;
	"expanded": boolean;
};

ts
import type { VNode, Ref, ReactiveEffect, ConcreteComponent, ComputedOptions, MethodOptions, RendererNode, RendererElement, ComponentPublicInstance, ComponentOptionsBase, ComponentProvideOptions } from 'vue';
import type { AsamTableContext, AsamTableV2Expose, AsamTableRefs, AsamTableColumnCtx, AsamTableV2HeaderCellSlotProps, AsamTableNativeEmits, AsamTableSort, AsamTableSize, AsamTableV2Props } from '@asam-ui/ui';

type PublicMember<T, K extends PropertyKey> = T extends unknown ? K extends keyof T ? T[K] : never : never;

// AsamTableContext
type PublicContract<T extends { [x: string]: any; [x: number]: any; [x: symbol]: any; } = any> = {
	"$ready": boolean;
	"hoverState"?: (AsamTableContext<T>)["hoverState"];
	"renderExpanded": (AsamTableContext<T>)["renderExpanded"];
	"store": (AsamTableContext<T>)["store"];
	"layout": (AsamTableContext<T>)["layout"];
	"refs": AsamTableRefs;
	"tableId": string;
	"state": AsamTableContext<T>["state"];
	"emit": AsamTableNativeEmits<T>;
	"effect": ReactiveEffect<any>;
	"data": AsamTableV2Expose["$refs"];
	"uid": number;
	"type": ConcreteComponent<{}, any, any, ComputedOptions, MethodOptions, {}, any>;
	"parent": AsamTableV2Expose["$"] | null;
	"root": AsamTableV2Expose["$"];
	"appContext": AsamTableContext<T>["appContext"];
	"vnode": VNode<RendererNode, RendererElement, { [key: string]: any; }>;
	"subTree": VNode<RendererNode, RendererElement, { [key: string]: any; }>;
	"update": () => void;
	"job": AsamTableContext<T>["job"];
	"proxy": ComponentPublicInstance<{}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, false, ComponentOptionsBase<any, any, any, any, any, any, any, any, any, {}, {}, string, {}, {}, {}, string, ComponentProvideOptions>, {}, {}, "", {}, any> | null;
	"exposed": Record<string, any> | null;
	"exposeProxy": Record<string, any> | null;
	"props": AsamTableV2Expose["$refs"];
	"attrs": AsamTableV2Expose["$refs"];
	"slots": AsamTableContext<T>["slots"];
	"isMounted": boolean;
	"isUnmounted": boolean;
	"isDeactivated": boolean;
};

AsamTableColumnCtx 公开类型视图
ts
import type { VNode } from 'vue';
import type { AsamTableColumnCtx, AsamTableV2HeaderCellSlotProps, AsamTableSize, AsamTableV2Expose, AsamTableOverflowTooltipFormatter, AsamTableV2Props, AsamTableSort } from '@asam-ui/ui';

// AsamTableColumnCtx
type PublicContract<T extends { [x: string]: any; [x: number]: any; [x: symbol]: any; } = { [x: string]: any; [x: number]: any; [x: symbol]: any; }> = {
	"id": string;
	"realWidth": number | null;
	"type": string;
	"label": string;
	"className": string;
	"labelClassName": string;
	"property": string;
	"prop": string;
	"width"?: string | number | undefined;
	"minWidth": string | number;
	"renderHeader": (AsamTableColumnCtx<T>)["renderHeader"];
	"sortable": string | boolean;
	"sortMethod": (a: T, b: T) => number;
	"sortBy": string | string[] | ((row: T, index: number, array?: T[]) => string);
	"resizable": boolean;
	"columnKey": string;
	"rawColumnKey": string;
	"align": string;
	"headerAlign": string;
	"showOverflowTooltip"?: (AsamTableColumnCtx<T>)["showOverflowTooltip"];
	"tooltipFormatter"?: AsamTableOverflowTooltipFormatter<T> | undefined;
	"fixed": string | boolean;
	"formatter": (row: T, column: AsamTableColumnCtx<T>, cellValue: any, index: number) => VNode | string;
	"selectable": (row: T, index: number) => boolean;
	"reserveSelection": boolean;
	"filterMethod": (AsamTableColumnCtx<T>)["filterMethod"];
	"filteredValue": string[];
	"filters": AsamTableColumnCtx<T>["filters"];
	"filterPlacement": string;
	"filterMultiple": boolean;
	"filterClassName": string;
	"index": number | ((index: number) => number);
	"sortOrders": (AsamTableSort["order"] | null)[];
	"renderCell": (data: any) => VNode | VNode[];
	"colSpan": number;
	"rowSpan": number;
	"children"?: AsamTableColumnCtx<T>[] | undefined;
	"level": number;
	"filterable": (AsamTableColumnCtx<T>)["filterable"];
	"order": AsamTableSort["order"] | null;
	"isColumnGroup": boolean;
	"isSubColumn": boolean;
	"columns": AsamTableColumnCtx<T>[];
	"getColumnIndex": () => number;
	"no": number;
	"filterOpened"?: boolean | undefined;
	"renderFilterIcon"?: ((scope: any) => VNode) | undefined;
	"renderExpand"?: ((scope: any) => VNode) | undefined;
};
